thread.title: PickCo Board of DD Superintendent placed on leave - NewsBreak

author: David Horning
title: PickCo Board of DD Superintendent placed on leave - NewsBreak
text:
By David Horning ,
10 hours ago
Dear Parents, Guardians, Family Members, and People with Disabilities served by Pickaway DD,
This message is to inform you that, following a special meeting of the Pickaway County Board of Developmental Disabilities last night, Superintendent Marie Wilbanks has been placed on paid administrative leave pending the outcome of an independent investigation related to anonymous allegations received by members of the Board last week.
The Board wants to reassure families and community members that these allegations do not involve the safety or wellbeing of individuals with developmental disabilities served by the County Board, nor do they involve allegations regarding County Board employees. The allegations primarily concern matters outside the direct scope of official Board operations. However, the Board believed it was important and appropriate to review any allegations that could potentially relate to the responsibilities of the Superintendent position.
As a Board, we remain committed to being as transparent as possible whenever information can legally and responsibly be shared. That commitment has always existed, and it will continue throughout this process.
The Board is retaining a law firm to conduct the independent third-party investigation to ensure the matter is reviewed thoroughly and objectively.
At this time, the Board is finalizing the process of appointing an interim superintendent to help ensure continuity of leadership and services. We anticipate announcing this appointment soon. In the meantime, Amanda Fay, Director of Business, Finance, and Operations, is overseeing day-to-day operations to ensure continuity of services and organizational stability.
Most importantly, we want families to know that the services and supports provided to individuals served by the County Board will continue uninterrupted. The health, wellbeing, and support of the individuals and families we serve remain our highest priority.
As both a Board member and a parent of five children served by Pickaway DD, I understand firsthand the trust families place in organizations like ours and the importance of maintaining stable, compassionate, and reliable services.
The Board understands that situations like this can create uncertainty and concern. Please know that we remain committed to ensuring that the organization continues operating in a professional, stable, and mission-focused manner.
Board Member Judy Wolford, who also formerly served as Pickaway County Prosecutor, will be coordinating this process on behalf of the Board.
While there are limitations regarding what can appropriately be shared at this time, additional information will be communicated as the process concludes and as information becomes legally and appropriately available to share.
We sincerely appreciate your trust, patience, and continued partnership as we remain focused on serving the individuals and families of Pickaway County.
If you have any questions or concerns please feel free to contact me or Judy Wolford jwolford@pickawaydd.org.
Sincerely,
Cara Layne
Board President
Pickaway County Board of Developmental Disabilities
